svg.title: Azure Speech SDK: Pick the Call
svg.desc: A SpeechConfig from azure-cognitiveservices-speech is created with the Foundry resource key and endpoint. For recognition, a SpeechRecognizer: a short command uses recognize_once_async, one utterance of about 30 seconds; dictation or long speech uses start_continuous_recognition with recognized handlers; an archive of recordings uses batch transcription with SAS URIs, asynchronous. For synthesis, set speech_synthesis_voice_name, create a SpeechSynthesizer and call speak_text_async(text).get(), which speaks in a neural voice.
svg.text: Azure Speech SDK: Pick the Call
One SpeechConfig; a recognizer to listen, a synthesizer to speak. Match the call to the job.
